scope: posthoc mechanism diagnosis fixed before diagnostic execution; no confirmatory or policy-selection use
execution_requires: complete development_seal.json plus independent exact-prefix/source verification
population: all 288 Loss2 primary slots, with every non-completed slot retained; completed slots are recorded without diagnostic execution
origin: original warmup plus exact saved committed actions; same complete theta/m/v/clock/RNG/context for all four branches
thresholds: all four exact original warmup old-panel losses, zero slack
configuration: unchanged original configuration for that slot; original action box, effort price, objective and 0-or-2 relinearizations
planner_branches: unchanged frozen make_plan, then unchanged exact repair_sequence, then independent actual action/receipt/state/four-panel replay
parameter_hold: at each step compute u=(theta_before-theta_after_actual_Adam)/dt; reject outside the original coordinate box; actually advance and verify all four original thresholds; no widening or fallback substitution
hold_float_semantics: record exact theta equality and maximum floating-point drift; only actual full H8 threshold checks establish a safe witness
prediction_errors: evaluate each available returned map at reference_terminal+maps*(exact_certified_Full_or_hold_actions-final_nominal_actions); bind both action and nominal/reference identities
prediction_attribution: different final SQP nominals are explicitly recorded; cross-model errors alone are not pure compression effects
source_labels: planning-only current_train plus four current and four old panels; no future_test/old_test labels or selection arrays loaded
missing_or_corrupt_origin: retain unavailable outcome and all four unavailable branch records; never substitute the warmup as the alleged stopped state
original_errors: preserve original stop/error status; a valid prefix can support diagnosis but never rescues primary eligibility
cost: separate diagnostic CPU/wall, including every planning, failed repair, verification, and hold trial; original measured policy cost untouched
interpretation: a certified Full or hold branch is an existence witness at that exact origin; lack of a bounded witness is not global nonlinear infeasibility
